items.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
items.summary: Claude agents searched a sequence database and flagged a previously unknown enzyme family, array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART), whose layout resembles CRISPR. The run used about 950 agents over 21 hours; humans wrote the prompt and did lab validation. Its function is not yet known.
items.why_it_matters: A concrete example of many agents running a long open-ended search with humans verifying the result.
evidence_quotes: we don't yet know its function

items.title: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
items.summary: Anthropic is partnering with Accenture's Faculty division on independent evaluation of frontier models, with evaluators embedded inside Anthropic. Both companies expect to invest at least $1 billion over five years.
items.why_it_matters: Outside model evaluation is being funded like a real industry.
evidence_quotes: evaluating and red-teaming models, conducting alignment assessments, and testing model safeguards
expect to invest at least $1 billion

items.title: OpenAI extends cyber access to Ukraine for civilian defense
items.summary: OpenAI is extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine for cyber defense of civilian infrastructure. The feed does not say what Daybreak includes.
items.why_it_matters: Frontier labs now grant specific governments access to security-focused programs.
evidence_quotes: extending access to its Daybreak program to the Government of Ukraine
